baseWeights: Existing pinned local encoder identities in encoders.py; downloads disabled
head: attention
headInitialization: fresh seeded parameters; no frozen-head warm start in this matrix
backboneMode: eval throughout training; only upper-layer weights receive gradients; no layerdrop, backbone dropout or SpecAugment
preprocessing: Exact pinned feature extractor, one unpadded waveform at a time
featureNormalization: Per-frame mean and standard deviation from the same fold/phase fit speakers in the matching pinned frozen feature cache; fixed throughout adaptation
objective: Mean per-rater natural-log loss over eligible phone-position rating distributions; all target rows within each accumulated clip group receive equal weight
selection: Within each encoder/depth/seed/fold run, select epoch by inner-speaker macro-target log loss only; exact ties retain the earlier epoch
outerRefit: A separate cold-start fixed-epoch run must reference the completed matching inner report, unchanged source hashes, and identical hyperparameters; outer labels/audio are evaluated only after fitting completes
stagedExecution: Start wav2vec2 upper-one-layer fold 0 as pilot. Inspect actual epoch runtime, finite gradients and inner validation before continuing the serial MPS matrix. Any abandoned path must retain its failed/stopped status and reason; no outer metrics may inform this decision.
execution: Local MPS serial adaptation jobs; CPU-only frozen-head jobs may run separately; no paid compute
resumability: Atomic last checkpoint saves optimizer, upper encoder state, head, CPU/MPS/Python/NumPy generator state, epoch/order/cursor and loss counters. Versioned selected checkpoints are written before last references their exact hash.
reporting: Retain every attempted configuration, status, inner curves, selected epoch, exact source/base/cache/cohort bindings, trainable parameter counts, memory/runtime and saved-checkpoint replay. Keep frozen and non-acoustic baselines on the same split.

longestInnerFitClip.selection: Maximum waveform sample count among fold-0 inner-fit clips, without using rating labels

gradientPreflight.timingLimitation: Tiny same-clip operator checks exclude varying-length compilation and cannot forecast full epoch time. Transient preflight weights were discarded.
